name: Candlestick (OHLC) & Volume
summary: Daily OHLC candles over an up / down coloured volume panel with moving averages, event pins and a zoom that opens on the last six months.
summary_zh: 日 K 线（开高低收）+ 按涨跌着色的成交量副图，叠加移动均线与事件标注，默认显示最近 6 个月并可缩放。
description_zh: 展示每个交易日的开盘、最高、最低、收盘价：实体颜色取主题的 pos（收涨）/ neg（收跌），影线为当日高低区间；下方成交量柱按当日涨跌着色。交易日放在类别轴上，周末与节假日不留空隙；默认显示最近约 6 个月，可滚轮/拖动缩放或用右上角 1M/3M/6M/YTD/1Y/All 切换，纵轴随可见 K 线自动重算。十字准星提示框给出 OHLC、较前收盘的涨跌额与涨跌幅、成交量和均线值；绑定 price_events 可在 K 线上方显示编号事件。适合交易层面的价格行为分析，不适合多只股票对比。
best_for: Recent trading behaviour of a stock (gaps, intraday ranges, reversals)
Price reaction around results, guidance or M&A news
avoid_when: Comparing several stocks (use line with rebase: 100)
Long multi-year history where daily detail is noise (use price-volume)

volume.desc: Traded volume; the panel is hidden when missing or volume: false

ma.desc: Simple moving averages of the close in trading days; [] for none

volume.desc: Volume panel with bars coloured by the day's direction

lastPrice.desc: Last close tag on the right axis, coloured by the day's move

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color}] horizontal price lines (offer, unaffected price), dashed in the theme's reference colour

eventsData.desc: Dataset id of events (date, label, kind, detail) drawn as numbered pins above the candles

eventsEncode.desc: Field mapping of the events dataset

rangeSelector.desc: Quick range buttons (top-right); true or a subset such as ['1m','3m','6m','all']

volumeShare.desc: Share of the plot height used by the volume panel (0.1–0.5)

format.desc: Price format (defaults to the close field format)

volumeFormat.desc: Volume format in the tooltip (defaults to the volume field format)

zoom.desc: Slider, drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch zoom shared by both panels (options.wheelZoom: true for the plain wheel); the price axis re-fits to the visible candles

interactions: Crosshair tooltip: OHLC, change vs. prior close, volume, MAs
Hover near a pin to read the event
Zoom shared by candles and volume: slider; Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom; drag to pan (plain wheel scrolls the page)
Range buttons (1M / 3M / 6M / YTD / 1Y / 2Y / 5Y / All, as the history allows)
